title: Simon Mayes — Type II Fun
subtitle: Writing by Simon Mayes on software quality, developer experience, and the slow work of building Untether.

posts.title: Software Quality Is Not Cyber Security
posts.description: AI gets you functional code. Quality-conscious prompting gets you further. But that's only 30% of the security controls — the other 70% aren't in your codebase.

posts.title: Keep the screen in your pocket
posts.description: Don't ditch the smartphone — reconfigure your relationship with it. Use a constrained smartwatch, shift essential interaction to it, and keep your phone out of sight.

posts.title: Stop generating, start rendering: personal apps backed by your System of Record
posts.description: AI spews static artefacts that rot the moment you edit. Stop duplicating — vibe-code disposable apps that render live views from your System of Record.
